fr.elements: Main Building; Secondary Building; Solar Panel System; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Internal Drive Aisle; Dumpster Enclosure; Landscaped Area; Walkway; Access Road
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Multiple Structures; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark each access point with visible signage identifying the access route name or number to help responders navigate to the correct entry quickly.

• Post building identification signs at both the main building and secondary building, visible from the internal drive aisle.

• Mark the internal drive aisle with directional signage distinguishing routes to the main building, secondary building, and any rear access points.

• Keep the dumpster enclosure clear of the drive aisle to avoid blocking emergency vehicle movement between structures.

• Trim dense vegetation along the rear of the property to maintain a clear path for responders approaching from that direction.

• Mark any limited rear access points with reflective signage indicating weight limits, width restrictions, or dead-end conditions if applicable.

• Keep the vehicle parking areas clear of overflow vehicles that could block emergency vehicle staging near either structure.

• Keep walkways between the main and secondary buildings clear of obstructions to allow responder movement on foot between structures.

• Confirm that solar panel system locations and roof access points are marked or documented in a site plan available to arriving responders.

• Post a simple site map at the primary access road entry showing the locations of both structures, the drive aisle, and any rear access limitations.

wildfire.conditions: Large Paved Area; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Building; Open Paved Area; Landscaped Island; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim trees within the scattered tree areas where branches extend close to building walls or rooflines.
• Thin vegetation growing directly against or immediately beside the building walls.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the landscaped island located near the building.
• Keep the landscaped island vegetation low and separated from any adjacent tree canopy.
• Maintain the large paved area and open paved surfaces free of vegetation encroachment along edges and cracks.
• Keep all access routes and drive lanes clear of overhanging branches that could obstruct emergency vehicle movement.
• Thin shrubs or plants concentrated within the tree cluster closest to any building.
